description: Config-driven browser flow descriptor for China Mobile cloud-drive SMS login guidance and current-session capture from the live headed browser.
notes: This catalog reuses the same browser-flow and CDP stack used by the Unicom and Telecom auth assistants.
Do not store live Authorization headers, cookies, phone numbers, SMS codes, or other secrets in this file.
